content.text:
* NMOS-input folded-cascode OTA with wide-swing mirror load.
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* Reference conversion and tail.
XNR IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XNT TAIL IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=3
XINP FP VINP TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=2
XINN FN VINN TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=2
* PMOS current sources, 30 uA per side.
XNBP PB IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XPR PB PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XPTP FP PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=3
XPTN FN PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=3
* PMOS cascode gate: resistor establishes upper-device headroom.
RPC VDD PCS 25000
XPCREF PC PC PCS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=33.333333 l=4 nf=1 m=1
XNPC PC IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XPCP MIR PC FP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=50 l=4 nf=1 m=1
XPCN VOUT PC FN VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=50 l=4 nf=1 m=1
* NMOS wide-swing cascode bias and current mirror.
XPNC NC PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XNCREF NC NC NCS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=2 nf=1 m=1
RNC NCS VSS 25000
XNCP MIR NC NL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=30 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XNCN VOUT NC NR VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=30 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XNLP NL MIR VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=4 nf=1 m=1
XNLN NR MIR VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=4 nf=1 m=1
CDOM VOUT VSS 6p
.ends DUT
